To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the multiple-shell structures of laser cooled 24Mg ions in a quadruple storage ring have been studied experimentally.

multiple concentric shells are observed in the experiment, that the experimental findings are in good qualitative and quantitative agreement with molecular dynamics calculations, that the shell structure is observed at ion densities of about 1010 ions per cm2, and that the observed shell structures are not stable against perturbations.
multiple-shell structures of laser cooled ions in a quadruple storage ring are observed and that they are in good agreement with molecular dynamics calculations.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the creation of multiple-shell ion structures and their study by means of molecular dynamics calculations.
the creation of ordered ion beams and their application in high-resolution spectroscopy and the study of ion-ion interactions.
the creation of ordered ion structures in the quadrupole storage and cooling ring ESR.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the multiple-shell structures are the result of a balance between the Coulomb repulsion and the transverse restoring force of the storage ring.
the observed multiple-shell structures are the result of the interplay between the ion-ion Coulomb repulsion and the external potential of the quadrupole ring.
